boundaries.first_token: first streamed chunk containing native generated tokens
boundaries.inter_token: only when every observed chunk contains exactly one token
boundaries.memory: native worker PyTorch allocator peaks and unique KV tensor storage; not device-wide memory usage
boundaries.request_start: admitted client request submitted to AsyncLLM.generate
boundaries.throughput: completed requests and native output tokens divided by whole measured batch windows
boundaries.transport: local native serving API; excludes HTTP/network overhead

unavailable.allocated_kv_bytes: native individual-token intervals or CUDA allocation evidence are unavailable
unavailable.peak_device_allocated_bytes: native individual-token intervals or CUDA allocation evidence are unavailable
unavailable.peak_device_reserved_bytes: native individual-token intervals or CUDA allocation evidence are unavailable

workload.isolation: public prefix-cache reset before every trial; allocator peaks reset after warmup
workload.schedule: bounded concurrent requests in input order

reasons: tokenizer chat-template identity is not observable
applied configuration contains only fields exposed by the vLLM engine
